```{r}
# Load in jsonlite package
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
#Assign Node Data and get a snapshot

#datausers_nominal <- stream_in(file("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/user_info.json"))
#head(datausers)
#data_annotate <- stream_in(file(("//Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/annotation_info.json")))
#head(data_annotate)
#songinfo <-  stream_in(file(("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/song_info.json")))
#head(songinfo)
# save(datausers_nominal, data_annotate, songinfo, file = "/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata" )

library(igraph)

# Load in Node data
load("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata")

# Assign Edge Data
edges_nominal <- read.csv("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/follows.csv")

valid_users <- intersect(
  unique(data_annotate$user[!is.na(data_annotate$user)]),
  intersect(
    intersect(unique(datausers_nominal$url_name),
              unique(edges_nominal$follower)),
    unique(edges_nominal$following)
  )
)

edges_reduced <- edges_nominal[edges_nominal$follower %in% valid_users &
                                 edges_nominal$following %in% valid_users,
                               c("follower", "following")]

valid_nodes    <- datausers_nominal[datausers_nominal$url_name %in% valid_users, ]
valid_annotate <- data_annotate[data_annotate$user %in% valid_users, ]

## ---- CHANGED: one genre per user from ALL of their annotations ----

# Song-level tag lookup (first listed tag for each song)
top_tag <- function(x) {
  x <- unlist(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}
song_tags <- data.frame(
  key = tolower(songinfo$url_name),
  tag = vapply(songinfo$tags, top_tag, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
song_tags <- song_tags[!duplicated(song_tags$key), ]

# Tag every annotation of the valid users
valid_annotate$tag <- song_tags$tag[match(tolower(valid_annotate$song), song_tags$key)]
mean(is.na(valid_annotate$tag))        # share of annotations with no genre

# Most frequent tag per user, ties broken at random (reproducible)
mode_tag <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tb  <- table(x)
  top <- names(tb)[tb == max(tb)]
  if (length(top) == 1) top else sample(top, 1)
}
set.seed(585)
user_tag <- tapply(valid_annotate$tag, valid_annotate$user, mode_tag)
user_tags <- data.frame(url_name = names(user_tag),
                        tag = as.character(user_tag),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# One profile row per user, then attach the tag
nodes_one     <- valid_nodes[!duplicated(valid_nodes$url_name), ]
nodes_reduced <- merge(nodes_one, user_tags, by = "url_name", all.x = TRUE)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(nodes_reduced$url_name))
nrow(nodes_reduced)                    # should equal length(valid_users)
nrow(nodes_reduced) == length(valid_users) #TRUE
sum(is.na(nodes_reduced$tag))          # users with no usable genre
sort(table(nodes_reduced$tag), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Drop self-loops and duplicate rows
edges_final <- edges_reduced[edges_reduced$follower != edges_reduced$following, ]
edges_final <- unique(edges_final)

# Keep only nodes with at least one remaining edge
keep_ids    <- unique(c(edges_final$follower, edges_final$following))
nodes_final <- nodes_reduced[nodes_reduced$url_name %in% keep_ids, ]

stopifnot(all(unlist(edges_final) %in% nodes_final$url_name))
stopifnot(all(nodes_final$url_name %in% keep_ids))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(nodes_final$url_name))

# Split up stats data frame
nodes_final$annotations    <- nodes_final$stats$Annotations
nodes_final$suggestions    <- nodes_final$stats$Suggestions
nodes_final$transcriptions <- nodes_final$stats$Transcriptions
nodes_final$questions      <- nodes_final$stats$Questions
nodes_final$answers        <- nodes_final$stats$Answers
nodes_final$pyongs         <- nodes_final$stats$Pyongs
nodes_final <- subset(nodes_final, select = -stats)

# Roles to boolean variables
all_roles <- sort(unique(unlist(nodes_final$roles)))
for (r in all_roles) {
  col <- paste0("role_", make.names(r))
  nodes_final[[col]] <- vapply(nodes_final$roles, function(x) r %in% x, logical(1))
}
nodes_final <- subset(nodes_final, select = -roles)

# Build graph
g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges_final, vertices = nodes_final, directed = TRUE)

plot(g, vertex.label = NA, vertex.size = 0.5, edge.arrow.size = 0.2)
```
G(n,p) graph visualization 
```{r, echo=TRUE}
# Small standalone graph (no copy of the big one)
sampled_nodes <- sample(V(g),250 )
induced <- induced_subgraph(g,sampled_nodes)
E(induced)$color <- "blue"
plot(induced, vertex.label = NA, layout = layout_with_fr(induced), 
     vertex.size = 0.7, edge.arrow.size = 0.5) #Not pretty

#Number of Isolates
n_iso <- sum(degree(induced) == 0)

# Suppress Isolates from this visualization
g_plot <- delete_vertices(induced, which(degree(induced) == 0))

set.seed(00)
lay <- layout_with_fr(g_plot)

viz <- plot(g_plot,
     layout = lay,
     vertex.label = NA,
     vertex.size = 3 + 2 * sqrt(degree(g_plot, mode = "in")),   # size by in-degree (popularity)
     vertex.color = adjustcolor("darkblue", 0.8),
     vertex.frame.color = NA,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.2,
     edge.arrow.width = 0.8,
     edge.color = adjustcolor("grey40", 0.5),
     edge.curved = 0.1, 
     main = "Induced Subgraph of 250 Randomly Sampled Nodes")
title(sub = paste(n_iso, "isolated nodes omitted"))
save(viz, file = "/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/inducedviz.png")
```
